description: The pie chart, titled "Stimulus Type," displays the distribution of various types of stimuli used in developing story case studies of generative AI's use in journalism, with each category represented by a colored segment and labeled with its corresponding percentage. The largest segment, colored dark red, represents "Draft/Other" at 26.4%. The second largest segment, in yellow, corresponds to "Press Release" at 18.7%, followed by "External News Article" in dark green at 18.1%. The "Interview" category, shown in dark blue, accounts for 8.8%, while "Organizational Report" in purple makes up 7.7%. "Event Posting" in a lighter red is 6.6%, and "Organizational Website" in light purple is 4.9%. The smallest segments are "Email" in light green at 2.7% and "Social Media Post" in a very thin orange slice at 1.1%. The chart visually emphasizes the "Draft/Other" category as the most significant, with the remaining categories decreasing in proportion, and the percentages are clearly labeled next to their respective segments.
